1e3bb4b.summary: Proposal UX polish, schedule previews, and sleeping limit clarity
changes: Deleting a draft removes it from the list immediately
Proposed batch sleeping nights appear on the schedule in yellow (proposed styling)

Preference alerts use first names then pronouns (e.g. Katie is sleeping with Michael… her limit… with them)
Sticky tabs on Proposals and sticky week/filters on Schedule while scrolling
Renamed Logistics & Configuration to People and Places; Sleeping Rules to Sleeping Partners
Partner max nights counted Sunday–Saturday; warns but still allows over-limit scheduling

f79e8f7.summary: Re-draft, recurring proposals, and private event redaction
changes: Re-Draft approved or archived events from the schedule or proposals (proposers and approvers)
Re-drafting updates proposer when someone other than the original submits the edit
Recurring events and sleeping arrangements: daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly (2–52 occurrences)
Delete or re-draft a recurring instance with this occurrence vs all future scope
Hide private and super private details in Resolved and Archived proposal tabs for non-invitees
Split create proposal type picker: Event on one row, sleeping options on the next

Load OAuth Client ID, API Key, and Calendar ID from notify service env vars on every device
Expose credentials via GET /v1/config and POST /v1/auth/login with serverManaged flag
Hide manual credential fields in Admin when the notify service manages Google setup
Retry loading server credentials from the connect gate when bootstrap fetch fails
